name: Thirty-eight-pilot replay CNN SFT into original full-action PPO
frozen: Common controller seed within physical host on original Normal credits; title-specific stocks; no automatic shooting/bombing or geometric control.
initialization: Directly restore four human-trained CNN action heads after 25,286 updates on 134,857 unique training windows, 38 pilots. Initialize native value head to zero. Same original PPO optimizer settings and event terms as the registered Normal continuation.
reward: Preserve event reward and PPO hyperparameters of the parent continuation, verify restored TH10 register, qualify TH12 original outcomes, use native TH13 stage progress for time. This trial evaluates the whole registered update. Impact of batch size alone requires a matched small-batch control.
test: 16 fresh TRAIN full credits per title, 24 independent paired Normal stock credits per title for pure SFT and its PPO descendant. Match controller sampling seed and physical host for each pair. The native game RNG remains independent. Stage 2 and remaining resources require original calibrated evidence. TH13 primary supporting continuous metric is observed Stage 1 script time. No assists.
